title: List the names of all cards illustrated by 'Chippy' that have unknown power
question: List the names of all cards illustrated by 'Chippy' that have unknown power (either null or '*') and are banned in the play format that has the highest total number of banned cards.

prediction.sql:
WITH MaxBanned AS (
    SELECT "XCL_084" AS format_id
    FROM legalities
    WHERE "XCL_085" = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY "XCL_084"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON c."XCL_072" = l."XCL_086"
INNER JOIN MaxBanned AS mb ON l."XCL_084" = mb.format_id
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'Chippy'
  AND (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
  AND l."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
